mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) indicates imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signal weakening consumer demand for durable goods, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or joint Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of unemployment below 4.0% (UNRATE < 4.0%) and job growth exceeding 100k (PAYEMS > 100k) indicates a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting both conditions, or joint Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (INDPRO < 100.0) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing starts above 1,100 thousand units (HOUST > 1100) signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand, preceding higher corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and rising rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), monetary tightening reduces corporate profitability and increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting both conditions, or joint Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment below 4.0% (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals labor market tightening that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
